description: Source code for bugreportz utility handling bug report data streams, including reading from file descriptors, filtering lines, and outputting data with progress indication.

methods.name: write_line
methods.description: Outputs a line to stdout unless it is a progress or begin line and show_progress is false.

methods.name: bugreportz
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor, processes line by line, and outputs it, handling progress display based on show_progress flag.

methods.name: bugreportz_stream
methods.description: Streams data from a file descriptor directly to stdout, handling timeouts and errors.
